title: Puharich helped find psi children in the US and the UK
summary: Greg tells of Puharich helped find psi children in the US and the UK, about 1970s–1980s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he he openly says, I helped locate these kids.

plain: A researcher named Greg, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says that Andrija Puharich, a scientist the episode connects to the CIA, the US intelligence agency, openly said he helped locate children with psi abilities, meaning psychic powers, in the United States and Britain during the 1970s and 1980s. According to Greg, Puharich put it simply: "I helped locate these kids." If true, it would mean someone was actively searching for gifted children for a purpose.
